facts.fact: ZIMRA says TaRMS, replacing SAP TRM for domestic taxes, launched its Return Management, Payments Management, Taxpayer Accounting and Debt Management modules on 6 December 2023, with Release 2 live from 29 February 2024.
ZIMRA says TaRMS replaced SAP TRM as the domestic taxes system, going live in phases from 12 October 2023.

systems.country_label: Zimbabwe Revenue Authority Tax and Revenue Management System
